/* rt_c_fcsr.c - Round-trip fixture: fcsr (frm + sticky fflags) across the
 * handoff (L20).
 *
 * Phase 1 (QEMU1): set fcsr = 0x21 (frm=RTZ(1)<<5 | fflags=NX) right
 *   before the enter marker; the plugin drains it into
 *   hybrid_state_v1.fcsr (offset 5456, locked by state_abi_check.h).
 * Phase 2 (vsim): ResumeDriver must restore fcsr before the ROI runs.
 *   The in-ROI self-check reads it back; on mismatch the fixture exits 1
 *   immediately, so the vsim leg returns 1 instead of 200 and the harness
 *   fails loudly. On success it writes the distinct sentinel 0x45
 *   (frm=RDN(2)<<5 | fflags=NX|UF) for StateDrain to capture at the exit
 *   marker -- the drained file's fcsr field must read 0x45
 *   (tests/hybrid/e2e_fcsr_roundtrip.sh asserts both file values).
 *
 * crt0.S sets mstatus.FS=Initial, so fcsr is writable in M-mode on both
 * engines. The insns after the exit marker (main's epilogue) touch no FP
 * state, so the drain's 0-3 insn halt slack cannot disturb the sentinel.
 */
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "runtime/rt_c_helpers.h"

int main(void)
{
  /* Phase 1 (QEMU1): non-default rounding mode + a sticky flag. */
  unsigned long set = 0x21; /* frm=RTZ | fflags=NX */
  asm volatile("csrw fcsr, %0" ::"r"(set));

  enter_vsim();

  /* Phase 2 (vsim): the restored fcsr must be intact. */
  unsigned long got;
  asm volatile("csrr %0, fcsr" : "=r"(got));
  if (got != 0x21)
    exit(1);

  /* Leave a distinct value for the exit drain to capture. */
  unsigned long sentinel = 0x45; /* frm=RDN | fflags=NX|UF */
  asm volatile("csrw fcsr, %0" ::"r"(sentinel));

  exit_vsim();

  return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# test_all.sh -- run the full andesim test surface. This is the entry point that
# replaced the former `andesim test` subcommand (which moved out of the binary).
#
# Phases (all run, in order, unless named explicitly):
#   unit      build/driver/andesim-*-test   the C++ driver unit tests
#   contract  tests/andes_sim/*.sh          driver feature contracts
#   e2e       scripts/run_e2e.sh            hybrid qemu+vsim round-trips
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/test_all.sh [--dry-run] [unit|contract|e2e ...]
#
# --dry-run prints the plan without executing (and without building). The
# contract and e2e phases need built artifacts -- run scripts/build_all.sh
# first. FILTER / MODE / JOBS pass through to scripts/run_e2e.sh unchanged.
set -uo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

DRY_RUN=0
PHASES=()
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    unit|contract|e2e) PHASES+=("$arg") ;;
    *)
      echo "test_all.sh: unknown argument: $arg" >&2
      echo "usage: test_all.sh [--dry-run] [unit|contract|e2e ...]" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done
[ "${#PHASES[@]}" -eq 0 ] && PHASES=(unit contract e2e)

step() { printf '\033[1;34m==>\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
ok()   { printf '\033[1;32m[ok]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() { printf '\033[1;31m[FAIL]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

pass=0
failed=0
declare -a FAILED_NAMES=()

# run_case NAME CMD...  -- execute one case, tally it, dump its log on failure.
run_case() {
  local name="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then printf '  %s\n' "$name"; return; fi
  local log rc; log=$(mktemp)
  "$@" >"$log" 2>&1; rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
    ok "$name"; pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    fail "$name (rc=$rc)"; failed=$((failed + 1)); FAILED_NAMES+=("$name")
    cat "$log"
  fi
  rm -f "$log"
}

run_unit() {
  step "[unit] C++ driver unit tests"
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
    printf '  %s\n' "scripts/build_driver.sh" "build/driver/andesim-*-test (each)"
    return
  fi
  if ! bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null; then
    fail "[unit] build_driver.sh failed"; failed=$((failed + 1)); return
  fi
  shopt -s nullglob
  local bins=("$ROOT"/build/driver/andesim-*-test)
  shopt -u nullglob
  if [ "${#bins[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
    fail "[unit] no unit-test binaries under build/driver"; failed=$((failed + 1)); return
  fi
  local t
  for t in "${bins[@]}"; do run_case "[unit] $(basename "$t")" "$t"; done
}

run_contract() {
  step "[contract] driver feature contracts"
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
    printf '  %s\n' "tests/andes_sim/test_andes_sim_*.sh (each)"
    return
  fi
  local s
  for s in "$ROOT"/tests/andes_sim/test_andes_sim_*.sh; do
    [ -f "$s" ] || continue
    run_case "[contract] $(basename "$s")" bash "$s"
  done
}

run_e2e() {
  step "[e2e] hybrid qemu+vsim round-trips"
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then printf '  %s\n' "scripts/run_e2e.sh"; return; fi
  run_case "[e2e] run_e2e.sh" bash "$ROOT/scripts/run_e2e.sh"
}

for p in "${PHASES[@]}"; do
  case "$p" in
    unit)     run_unit ;;
    contract) run_contract ;;
    e2e)      run_e2e ;;
  esac
done

if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
  echo
  echo "(dry-run: nothing executed)"
  exit 0
fi

echo
step "summary: $pass passed, $failed failed"
if [ "$failed" -gt 0 ]; then
  fail "failed: ${FAILED_NAMES[*]}"
  exit 1
fi

Extend the QEMU1 -> vsim handoff to carry three more classes of writable
machine state that previously reset to their defaults inside the ROI. The
plugin now drains fcsr (frm + sticky fflags) alongside the FPRs under
HYBRID_FLAG_FP, so floating-point code in the window runs with the guest's
real rounding mode instead of RNE and the drained flags are live (L20). The

trap-free ROI -- restored at resume, re-read at drain -- and state_diff now
strictly compares them plus mscratch (L23); mip is transported and re-read
but excluded from verify because its pending bits are hardware/platform
driven and diverge between QEMU's functional clock and vsim's cycle clock
(L24). The plugin also drains the Andes machine-setup CSRs mcache_ctl (0x7CA)
and mmisc_ctl (0x7D0): crt0 enables the L1 caches via mcache_ctl on the
cache-less functional engine, so without transporting it vsim resumed with
caches off and ran the whole window uncached, inflating the cycle figure
severalfold (L21). All new restores are tolerant no-ops on an engine lacking
the CSR (a NULL gdbstub handle drains 0). rt_c_fcsr.c self-checks the
restored fcsr inside the ROI, rt_csr_survival.S guards the trap-CSR
round-trip in-ROI, and e2e_fcsr_roundtrip.sh asserts both drained values.
